caveats: Startup is process launch through first hover, with potentially warm OS/project artifacts; no OS cold boot or typing percentile claim.
Diagnostics time ends at the edited-document version notification, not all workspace diagnostics.
Memory is lifetime peak physical footprint, distinct from RSS and from a hard memory ceiling.
Mechanism timers nest and must not be added as independent totals.
SoC background freezes RTL and edits a separate consumer; original-file SoC scenario freezes packages and leaves the edited RTL native. SoC does not include UVM.

Direct retention is eligibility-based. Context-dependent type boundaries can still require a compact owner; CVA6 initially preserves the whole DUT with that fallback. Forced provider changes at manual rebuild may produce partial roots, as in baseline.
Public digests include fixture URIs; correctness is compared with the same-fixture Native oracle. Baseline and current UVM sources use identical canonical paths.
